data.name: Sage's Knowledge
data.description: A sage stores information on every topic and is happy to lecture its master on the finer points of a subject. A sage can attempt all Knowledge checks untrained and gains a bonus on Knowledge checks equal to half its master's class level. [SKILL RANK CHANGES NOT IMPLEMENTED] Additionally, a sage gains 2 skill ranks each time its master gains a class level. Its maximum number of ranks in any given skill is equal to its master's class level. This replaces the familiar's ability to share its master's skill ranks.
